infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Trace uses the camera to scan product barcodes so we can show you how processed it is and trace it back to source.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Trace lets you analyze food photos from your library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Trace uses your location to show the air, water and food around you, and the producers within reach.
